title: Community events run by Community Ambassadors
names_seen: Community events run by Community Ambassadors

facts.statement: Free Realms Community Ambassadors ran weekly community events where players gathered for kart races, home showcases, duels and other activities.
facts.quote: Los Embajadores de la Comunidad de Free Realms conducen eventos semanales

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Recopilacion de Eventos: Exhibición de Hogares y Desfile de Mascotas)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post recapping community-ambassador events: a New Year home showcase and a pet costume parade. It also explains how players find community events through the in-game Game Guide calendar. The page gives no exact post date (only 'Posted 1 year, 4 months ago' relative to capture).
